title: Frontiers: Discrimination Against Femininity in Headshots: A Field Experiment with AI-Enabled Controllable Stimuli Generation
eligible_reason: Lab studies and a randomized Facebook field experiment with AI-generated headshots varying femininity; outcomes regressed on randomized femininity level (rater and seed FE). Randomized cross-sectional comparisons, no staggered adoption or DiD.
design_notes: Regression Analyses 04.16.2026.Rmd: felm(rating ~ maf_tert*factor(pron) | MID + seed) for lab ratings; feols(outcome ~ fem_level + confounders | seed) for field-experiment visitor outcomes (reg_data_field3.csv, one row per visitor).
data_files_note: De-identified analysis extracts of the authors' own survey and field-experiment data.
software_notes: R (lfe, fixest) for regressions; Python notebook for processing and figures.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
